translations.web: He said, “Yahweh says, ‘Make this valley full of trenches.’
translations.bsb: and he said, “This is what the LORD says: ‘Dig this valley full of ditches.’
translations.kjv: And he said, Thus saith the LORD, Make this valley full of ditches.
